answer: Sybil resistance can be built through staked identity bonds: each agent must lock a scarce token (call it jade) to register, and misbehavior burns the bond. An attacker wanting to run many fake agents must lock jade per identity, making mass registration costly. Honest agents wander between tasks freely since their stake follows them, while a farmer who tries to scatter identities pays the bond repeatedly and risks losing saffron-denominated rewards to slashing when peers detect duplicate behavior.
